description: Land Title Settlement Department - Aluthgama Bogamuwa, Gampaha D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring determinations of land ownership for specific parcels in various locations. It contains detailed land parcel information, ownership details, and legal declarations regarding land titles, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
